title: Government Surveillance: Last Week Tonight with John Oliver (HBO)
summary: John Oliver interviews Edward Snowden about NSA surveillance, including street interviews showing people have not thought about what the government can see. The segment famously frames the issue through private photos.
why: HN points to it as the best way to explain to ordinary people why privacy and mass surveillance matter.

quote.text: I believe John Oliver provided the best example when he interviewed Edward Snowden.
